doc.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023

title: Residuals and voiceover stars like Eartha Kitt and Mel Torme
summary: He earned healthy residuals; Eartha Kitt and Mel Torme appeared on commercials.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: Do you get residuals or payments after the fact for any of this kind of work?

Yeah. Residuals. Obviously they’re more short term because the campaigns don’t last years and years and years generally. But I always got a healthy residual for anything that I did write. Not as much as the voiceovers but —
But there were some amazing voiceovers, you know people would come in and you’d be in awe of who showed up. Or singers, you know I did one with Eartha Kitt, I did one with
Mel Torme. It’s amazing to look back and think well, we did this commercial for soap or breakfast cereal and they flew Eartha Kitt into London. And she called me “sir.”
You know I considered doing that because I wonder, that I think you probably should get a knighthood, don’t you?
I don’t know. I’m happy with what I’ve got.
